Admonition Greyscale Probe
===========================

.. This fixture now carries seven boxes: note, tip, seealso, warning, then
   error, danger and attention -- the three red-family types -- deliberately
   adjacent, in that order, at the end. Adjacency is the point: gap G-39-1
   asks whether these three near-hue title bands separate once desaturated,
   and that is harder to judge if unrelated boxes sit between them. Each
   body is kept to one short line: seven boxes is one more than the fixture
   was originally sized for, and the file is sized against a hard one-page
   limit (39-RESEARCH.md Pitfall 4).

.. note::

   This box is the note directive.

.. tip::

   This box is the tip directive.

.. seealso::

   This box is the seealso directive.

.. warning::

   This box is the warning directive.

.. error::

   This box is the error directive.

.. danger::

   This box is the danger directive.

.. attention::

   This box is the attention directive.
